body:
The State Council published the 2027 holiday schedule on November 5th, 2026 (国办发明电〔2026〕10号, https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202611/content_7085101.htm). This adds it to the `China` calendars, in the same way as the previous years:

- SSE holidays: February 5th and 8th to 12th (Spring Festival), April 5th (Ching Ming), May 3rd to 5th (Labour Day), June 9th (Dragon Boat), September 15th (Mid-Autumn), October 1st and 4th to 7th (National Day). January 1st is already given by the existing rule.
- IB working weekends: January 31st, February 14th, May 8th, September 26th and October 9th.

The class documentation said that data were available for 2004-2019 only; it now says 2004-2027.

`testChinaSSE` and `testChinaIB` are extended to 2027. They fail on master (17 missing holidays; 80 working weekends instead of 85) and pass with the change.
title: Add Chinese holidays for 2027
